entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane in ruins after its many cataclysms and the Phyrexian invasion, with salt rains and poisoned air, where time itself is in trouble.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane that invaded Dominaria over two hundred years earlier and was defeated with its god Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: God of Phyrexia, defeated in the invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker whose placement of the Skyshroud Forest drained green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld; Teferi seeks her help to repair the plane.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who returns from his phased-out home and realizes the connection between land and mana is breaking.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: Forest whose placement by Freyalise caused the Skyshroud rift.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Region whose mountains caved in or withered after the Skyshroud rift drained its red mana.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion over two hundred years earlier that devastated Dominaria.

events.summary: Over two hundred years earlier Phyrexia invaded Dominaria; Phyrexia and Yawgmoth were defeated but only after devastating the plane.
events.quote: In the end Phyrexia and its god, Yawgmoth , were defeated, but not before they devastated Dominaria.

events.summary: Freyalise places the Skyshroud Forest by brute force, causing the Skyshroud rift to drain green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld.
events.quote: causing the Skyshroud rift to drain the green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld

events.summary: People, locations and objects from Dominaria's past appear and disappear on their own.
events.quote: people, locations and objects from the plane's past seem to appear and disappear on their own

events.summary: Teferi returns from his phased-out home, realizes the land-mana connection is breaking, and seeks Freyalise's help.
events.quote: He seeks the help of Freyalise to repair the plane.

relations.note: Seeks her help to repair the plane.
relations.quote: He seeks the help of Freyalise to repair the plane.
